name: Never Mind the Buzzcocks
description: Never Mind the Buzzcocks is a comedy panel game show with a pop and rock music theme. The show is infamous for its dry, sarcastic humour and scathing, provocative attacks on the pop industry.

videos.title: 1st Series Compilation
Merry Mind the Buzzcocks
videos.overview: Boy George, Noddy Holder, Louise Wener, Jonathan Ross

videos.title: Never Rewind the Buzzcocks
videos.overview:
An exclusive Video Killed the Radio Star edition of the hit music quiz show with host Mark Lamarr and resident team captains Phil Jupitus and Sean Hughes. With guests Jonathan Ross, Sarah Cracknell (St Etienne), Noddy Holder, Math Priest (Dodgy) and Mandy Smith.

As well as the usual laughs (The Intros round, ID Parade, Dance Hell etc.) there are three extra ‘Rock Hotel’ rounds. Jonathan Ross switches from suit-wearing smoothie to hotel trashing rock bad boy while Noddy and Math find brand new ways of hiding ladies underwear. Also, gasp as Sarah helps Phil dress as a roadie even fatter than himself!

videos.overview: Host Mark Lamarr and team captains Phill Jupitus and Sean Hughes are joined for a special festive edition of the quiz show by Mel C of chart-topping girl band the Spice Girls, Natalie Appleton of female pop quartet All Saints, Huey of hip-hop and funk trio the Fun Lovin' Criminals and singer Rick Wakeman.

videos.title: A Moving Tribute (Compilation)
videos.overview: A best of compilation for series 21.

videos.title: Buzzcocks... Imagine a Mildly Amusing Panel Show
videos.overview: Alan Yentob joins Simon Amstell to look back over the series' most talked about moments, including Amy Whitehouse spitting, Preston doing the walk of shame and Lily Allen looking like Olive from On the Buses.

videos.title: Technically, The Best Series Ever
videos.overview: A look back at what were technically some excellent moments from series 22. Featuring a galaxy of technically good celebrity bookings and many, many technically funny sentences.

videos.title: The Best Of Never Mind The Buzzcocks Exclusive DVD Featurette
videos.overview: Never Mind the Buzzcocks host Simon Amstell and team captain Phill Jupitus have a rare out of hours get together to look back at some exclusive, never-before-aired, deleted material from the last 3 series. This Exclusive DVD Featurette includes clips ranging from the too rude, too drunk, too nasty, too sweary, too awkward and in absolutely no instances too funny for TV.

Is there anything Meat Loaf won’t do for love ? Did Steve Jobs really invent the iPod ? What really happened on the day the music died and who actually let the dogs out ?
